service.method: SELECT count(*) FROM SNOTE WHERE nvl(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NOTE_TYPE = 'N' AND PUBLISH_FLAG = 'Y' AND GONGJI_GUBUN in ('A', ${session.USER_TYPE}) AND PUBLISH_FROM_DATE <= ${current.DATE} AND PUBLISH_TO_DATE >= ${current.DATE}

SELECT count(*) FROM SPRLN PRLN JOIN SPRGL PRGL ON PRLN.HOUSE_CODE = PRGL.HOUSE_CODE AND PRLN.COMPANY_CODE = PRGL.COMPANY_CODE AND PRLN.PR_NUMBER = PRGL.PR_NUMBER LEFT JOIN SPLNT PLNT ON PRLN.HOUSE_CODE = PLNT.HOUSE_CODE AND PRLN.COMPANY_CODE = PLNT.COMPANY_CODE AND PRLN.PLANT_CODE = PLNT.PLANT_CODE WHERE NVL(PRLN.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(PRGL.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND NVL(PRLN.PR_CLOSE_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND PRGL.PR_STATUS = 'E' AND PRLN.PR_STATUS IN ('S','P')
